description: This file defines the interface ReloadService for reloading entities in the Fineract project, including method signatures for checking reload capability and performing reloads.

classes.name: ReloadService
classes.description: A generic interface defining reload capabilities for entities extending AbstractPersistableCustom.

methods.name: canReload
methods.description: Determines if the provided entity can be reloaded.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Performs the reload operation on the provided entity.
